changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6c, item 3: journal.ts is now workflow-service's per-run durability owner. WorkflowJournal gains recover(record, now), moved verbatim from WorkflowService.recoverRunningRecords's reconciliation body (including the agentMatchesJournalResult helper); recoverRunningRecords shrinks to a loop calling it per running record. run.ts drops the redundant resultJournalCommitted/terminalJournalCommitted guard flags in favor of the journal's own idempotent ensureAgentResult/ensureTerminal commit-and-return, keeping resultCandidate/terminalCandidate unchanged. No persisted shape, log wording, or commit semantics change.
